Home
Fluid Tech Systems Rotary Gear Pumps

You need a pump that works every day without trouble. Fluid Tech Systems rotary gear pumps give you steady flow, simple operation, and long service life. You can use them for oils, chemicals, food products, and more. They handle thick liquids without losing performance.

Rotary gear pumps stay in demand. In 2026, the global positive displacement pump market crossed $18 billion. Analysts expect steady growth through 2026 due to rising demand in oil, food, and chemical industries. That tells you one thing. These pumps solve real problems.
How Rotary Gear Pumps Work
Rotary gear pumps use two rotating gears to move fluid. One gear drives the other. As they turn, they create suction and push liquid through the pump.
You get:
smooth flow
low pulsation
consistent pressure
That matters when you handle viscous fluids like oil, syrup, or chemicals.
Why It Matters
If your process needs steady output, this design works. You avoid pressure drops and uneven flow. That saves time and reduces waste.
Key Features You Can Expect
Strong Build
You get durable materials that handle tough conditions. Choose stainless steel or cast iron based on your application.
Handles Thick Liquids
These pumps move high-viscosity fluids without struggle. Many industries rely on them for this reason.
Easy Maintenance
You can clean and service the pump without complex tools. That reduces downtime.
Compact Design
You save space in your setup. Installation stays simple.
Types You Can Choose
Stainless Steel Pumps
If you work in food, pharma, or chemical industries, stainless steel works best. It resists corrosion and keeps your process clean.
Cast Iron Pumps
If your work involves oil, fuel, or industrial fluids, cast iron pumps handle heavy-duty tasks well.
Where You Can Use These Pumps
You can use fluid tech systems rotary gear pumps in:
oil and petroleum
food processing
chemical industries
paint and coatings
pharmaceuticals
A 2026 industry report shows that over 60 percent of viscous fluid handling systems use rotary gear pumps. That shows how widely they are trusted.
Benefits for Your Business
You want results. Here’s what you get:
steady flow improves product quality
fewer breakdowns save repair costs
easy operation reduces training time
long lifespan gives better return on investment
As pump expert John Carter says, “Rotary gear pumps remain one of the most reliable solutions for handling viscous fluids across industries.”
How to Choose the Right Pump
You should check:
Fluid Type
Is it thick, thin, or corrosive
Flow Rate
How much liquid you need per minute
Pressure Requirement
Make sure the pump meets your system demand
Material Compatibility
Choose SS or CI based on your process
If you pick the wrong pump, you face downtime and losses. Choose carefully.
FAQs
What is a rotary gear pump used for
You use it to move oils, chemicals, and thick liquids with steady flow.
How long does a gear pump last
With proper maintenance, it runs for years without major issues.
Can it handle high viscosity fluids
Yes. It works well with thick and sticky liquids.
Is maintenance difficult
No. You can service it easily with basic tools.
Which material is better SS or CI
SS works for food and chemicals. CI works for heavy industrial use.
Does it provide constant flow
Yes. It delivers smooth and continuous flow.
